thread:
maria.g: Quick sync reminder 1: hardware vendor roadmap check with NVIDIA/AMD/Habana + SI liaisons tomorrow 9am PT. Goals: firm H100/H200/B200 GA windows, MI300 distribution dates, Gaudi revB driver status, and how to sequence marketplace onramp + SI integrations.

oliver: Can we add announcement sequencing + embargo constraints to the agenda? Press needs clarity for joint comms.

sophie: Also need to confirm if any vendor requires a fixed hold period after driver sign-off (e.g., 7-14 days).

partner_ops_bot: Calendar reminder: meeting set for 2025-05-09 09:00 PT. Vendor-liaison, press-ops, SI leads invited.

devon: Infrastructure note: conservative H100 Dedicated capacity target 2025-06-18; H200 likely late July. B200 timing uncertain until supply confirmation (expect August).

ravi-plg: Hosted API preference: phased soft onramp for new hardware to validate batching/KV-cache. Can vendors provide early firmware & test images? Prebuilt quantized artifacts would be huge.

si-liaison: SI integration priority we recommend: 1) H100/H200, 2) MI300 (quantization paths), 3) Gaudi/B200 for lower-cost lanes. Driver maturity drives this order.

julia-press: Press ops: NVIDIA previously requested a 10-day embargo post-driver sign-off. If that's repeated, we'll need staggered announcement waves. Confirm with vendors.

maria.g: Proposed three-wave plan: Wave A = H100 (canary + early Dedicated); Wave B = MI300 + H200 (hosted + Dedicated); Wave C = Gaudi + B200 (broader marketplace). Space waves ~3 weeks to allow certs & supply. Thoughts?

devon: Agree. Add fallback rule: if vendor misses a wave, automatically route customers to a compatible variant (e.g., H100 -> H200 family) and mark announcement copy as "compatible with X family".

ravi-plg: Routing + cost-control policy must be defined before Wave B for MI300. Internal sims show ~30% token-cost variance for MI300 quantized vs fp16. Need clear docs and public-facing guidance.

si-liaison: SI needs: canary AMIs/images, driver bundles, integration checklist. We'll share a template snippet: `marketplace_onramp:
  wave: A
  canary_tag: canary-2025-05
  driver_bundle: v2.1.3
  si_checklist: [canary,driver,smoke-tests]`

sophie: Add a "late-driver-breaks" runbook item in the meeting: hold announcement, vendor triage, enable fallback region, notify customers. Assign owner to partner-ops.

maria.g: Will do. Also request vendors complete a short pre-meeting form: ETA for sign-off, embargo window, driver microcode caveats, and any perf regressions vs our baseline.

partner_ops_bot: Vendor form: https://forms.redwood.example/hw-onramp-2025 (auto-reminder in 12h).

nisha: Comms note: If embargo >=7 days we can run staged comms (feature blog first, then joint partner post). If >14 days, loop in legal earlier.

oliver: Ops ask: canary telemetry retention for initial canary cohort = 30d to detect regressions. Who can fund storage?

devon: Infra can provision temporary storage for Wave A canaries; will attach cost estimate to the tracker.

ravi-plg: For the sync, ask vendors if they can provide quantized export scripts (int8/4bit) or artifacts. That cuts onboarding time substantially.

si-liaison: Heads-up: Habana revB currently shows a kernel panic on long-sequence streaming; vendor patch ETA mid-May. If it slips, Gaudi moves to Wave C only.

maria.g: We'll make wave assignments conditional on sign-off. Pre-reads: compatibility matrix, canary runbook, press checklist, SI integration checklist.

oliver: Who's presenting the compatibility matrix? Ravi?

ravi-plg: I'll present and upload a short PDF by EOD.

maria.g: Perfect. Final: if you can't make 9am PT, DM me and we'll 1:1 the vendor. Otherwise see you all tomorrow. :calendar: :rocket:
